title: Elementary Events and Sample Space — Probability
hook: Let's explore Elementary Events and Sample Space from the chapter on Probability. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Elementary Events and Sample Space An elementary event has a single outcome. The sample space is the set of all possible outcomes. Sum of probabilities of all elementary events = 1. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Sample space: set of all possible outcomes of an experiment
💡 Elementary event: event with exactly one outcome
💡 Compound event: event with more than one outcome
💡 Sum of probabilities of all elementary events = 1
